- [ ] **Anti-Nerf Compliance**: I have NOT modified or nerfed any existing test in `tests/` (`npm run test:integrity` passed).

- [ ] **All Tests Pass**: `npm test` exited with code 0.
- [ ] **Regretful Commit Message**: My commit message contains NO conventional tags (`feat:`, `fix:`) and screams chaos or exhaustion (`npm run lint:commit` passed).
